Type: tall narrow bookcase
Use: storing books and display items; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, rustic
Materials: solid wood, rough-sawn drawer front, grey wash finish
Colors: light greyish natural wood
Shape: slim tall case, four open shelves, one middle drawer without handle, closed back, angled splayed legs, compact footprint
Feel: calm, natural, crafted
Goes with: white walls, light wood, linen, plants; Scandinavian or Japandi rooms

product.name: Stone & Beam Rylee Modern Bookcase 27.6"W x 76.8”H, Mixed Gray
product.description: Classic style with a modern flair make this bookcase unique. A mixed-gray finish adorns the 4 spacious niches, and the built-in drawer makes for extra storage capacity. The slim profile is ideal for small offices, libraries, and bedrooms. 27.6”W x 13.8”D x 76.8”H Wood Mixed gray finish adds a modern flair to this sturdy wood bookcase Full-size niches and a built-in drawer afford ample space for your collection. No assembly required Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
